protocol.finite_sensitivity: Canonical digits of each actual signed contribution modulo 71**D. Never use abs for digit support. Predictions and loss stay signed/untruncated.
protocol.inputs: Published, anonymous, checksum-pinned release. No raw catalogue access or database connection.
protocol.predictor: Signed integer sum; fitted training-only default iff the integer sum is zero. No reduction modulo 71**7.
protocol.residue_comparison: Canonical nonnegative lifts z mod 71**7 are used only for a structural counterfactual on the SAME predictions, not as a replacement predictor or refitted checkpoint model.
protocol.support: Exact infinite canonical p-adic support for the actual signed integer contributions; zeros omitted.

results.aggregation: Pooled summaries weight products; individual folds are retained.
results.interpretation: Descriptive post-hoc associations, not causal effects. All support variants group the same signed-integer predictions.
